zh: 很多人搞错了！
en: A lot of people get this wrong.

zh: AI时代，做产品越来越简单，
en: In the AI era, building products keeps getting easier,

zh: 但是能卖出去的人越来越少。
en: but fewer people can actually sell them.

zh: 只要是会Vibe Coding，
en: Anyone who knows Vibe Coding

zh: 谁手里没几个AI工具？
en: already has several AI tools.

zh: 谁不会搭智能体、跑流程、做自动化？
en: Who cannot build agents, workflows, and automation now?

zh: GitHub一扒一堆，
en: GitHub is full of ready-made options.

zh: 技术门槛已经彻底透明了。
en: The technical barrier has become transparent.

zh: AI把所有人的生产能力拉平了，
en: AI has levelled much of our production capacity,

zh: 技术不再是稀缺资源。
en: so technology is no longer the scarce resource.

zh: 那为什么很多人技术很强、产品很好，
en: Then why do technically strong people with good products

zh: 就是变现难？
en: still struggle to monetize?

zh: 因为现在缺的根本不是产品，
en: Because the real shortage is not products.

zh: 缺的是信任、曝光、人设和持续交付。
en: It is trust, exposure, identity, and consistent delivery.

zh: 你能做出来的AI产品，
en: Being able to build an AI product

zh: 不代表客户敢买单。
en: does not mean a customer will pay for it.

zh: 客户买的从来不是工具，
en: Customers are never really buying the tool.

zh: 是你能不能帮他落地、帮他去省钱，
en: They buy whether you can implement it and save them money,

zh: 能不能获客增收，
en: help them acquire customers and grow revenue,

zh: 能不能帮他解决真实的问题。
en: and solve a real problem.

zh: 当下普通人和技术创业者，
en: For ordinary people and technical founders today,

zh: 唯一的长线赛道只有一个：
en: there is one long-term path:

zh: AI加个人IP。
en: AI plus a personal brand.

zh: 既然能用AI做产品，
en: If you can use AI to build products,

zh: 那就必须用AI先做自己。
en: you should first use AI to build yourself.

zh: 你连自己的个人品牌、信任背书都搭建不起来，
en: If you cannot build your own brand and trust signals,

zh: AI产品根本没有溢价能力。
en: your AI product has no pricing power.

zh: 未来AI行业的竞争根本不是工具的竞争，
en: Future competition in AI is not about tools.

zh: 是商业认知的竞争。
en: It is about business understanding.

zh: 工具人人可以复制，
en: Anyone can copy a tool,

zh: 模板人人都可以下载。
en: and anyone can download a template.

zh: 但对于行业的拆解，
en: But understanding an industry,

zh: 对于老板的需求的洞察，
en: seeing what business owners truly need,

zh: 和长期陪跑的落地服务，
en: and delivering long-term implementation support

zh: 正是任何人复制不走的一个核心壁垒。
en: form a barrier that cannot be copied overnight.

zh: 技术只是入门，
en: Technology is only the entry point.

zh: 信任和落地服务才是AI创业的真正终局。
en: Trust and implementation service are the real endgame.

zh: 听懂的点个关注，
en: Follow if this makes sense to you.

zh: 我们一起做能落地、能变现的AI实干者。
en: Let us build practical AI work that can deliver and monetize.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
